title: Ordering Connectivity and Result Reporting Options, Physician Client Accounts
content:
How an organization holding Physician Client Accounts sends orders and receives results depends on its account class. The options cover an electronic health-record (EHR) ordering and results interface, the provider portal, paper requisitions, the ways results reach the organization and how quickly a critical result is telephoned.

## Options by class

| Account class | EHR interface can be built | Monthly requisitions needed for an interface | Provider portal ordering and results | Paper requisitions accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | No | 0 (not offered) | Yes | Yes |
| Group Practice Client Account | Yes | 400 | Yes | Yes |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | Yes | 400 | Yes | No |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | Yes | 250 | Yes | Yes |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | Yes | 200 | Yes | No |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | No | 0 (not offered) | Yes | Yes |

## Result reporting by class

| Account class | Ways results reach the organization | Critical result telephoned within (minutes after verification) |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | Provider portal, fax | 30 |
| Group Practice Client Account | EHR interface, provider portal, fax | 30 |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | EHR interface, provider portal | 30 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | EHR interface, provider portal, fax | 30 |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | EHR interface | 15 |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | Provider portal | 60 |

## Notes

- Every class can order and view results in the provider portal.
- A requisition figure of 0 means the class does not offer an EHR interface.
- Paper requisitions are not accepted from the Multispecialty Medical Group Account or the Hospital Outreach Reference Account.
- Fax delivery of results is available to the Independent Practice, Group Practice and Federally Qualified Health Center classes; the Hospital Outreach Reference Account receives results through the EHR interface only.
- The critical-result clock runs from verification of the result: 15 minutes for the Hospital Outreach Reference Account, 60 minutes for the Occupational Health Employer Account and 30 minutes for every other class.

## Illustration (hypothetical location)

A location sending about 300 requisitions a month reaches the 250 needed in the Federally Qualified Health Center Account and the 200 needed in the Hospital Outreach Reference Account, but not the 400 needed in the Group Practice and Multispecialty Medical Group classes.
